modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organise work as per organisation’s current health, safety and security policies and procedures
report any identified breaches in health, safety, and security policies and procedures to the designated person
identify the risks and hazards associated with work activities, their causes and prevention

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure work area is clean and tidy
ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
sanitize workstation and equipment regularly
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques
identify ways to optimise usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
use resources, including water, in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines and equipment
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use
identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste

KU4. precautions to be taken to ensure no damage is caused to the electrical/other advanced systems in case of hybrid/electric vehicles
KU5. any recommended changes in the process of fitment for the latest accessories w.r.t. a particular model/brand of vehicle
KU6. installation of newly launched technologically advanced accessories having complex electronics/electrical aggregates as per the prescribed process specified in the accessory
KU7. various provisions given by OEM in vehicles to install accessories such as markings, cuts,
KU8. SOP recommended by OEM to validate, diagnose and repair defect/fault in accessories fitted
KU9. various methods of activation and calibration of accessories, post fitment wherever applicable
KU10. safety, health and environmental policies and regulations for the workplace as well as for
KU11. SOPs regarding receiving vehicles, opening job card, allocation of work, invoicing, vehicle
KU12. maintenance requirement of different types of accessories
KU13. documentation required on the job (including job cards, work sheets, etc.) regarding the basic details of repair, maintenance and service performed
KU14. basic technology used in and functioning of various accessories specified by the OEM

gs: GS1. read and interpret workplace related documentation
GS2. interpret the needs of customers by understanding the key issues
GS3. communicate using terms, names, grades and other nomenclature pertaining to the automotive trade
GS4. analyse and apply the information gathered from observation, experience, reasoning or communication to act efficiently
GS5. identify potential workplace problem and take suitable action

pcs.pc_description: review the job card and understand work to be carried out to install the accessories
identify the auto component and accessories manufacturer specifications related to the various brand/model/variant of vehicle
collect tools, equipment and accessories required for the job depending upon the brand/model/variant of the vehicle, and check their condition
follow standard operating procedure to validate and diagnose faults in various accessories
report the defects/malfunctions if any, in the tools, equipment & accessories to the person concerned for rectification
co-ordinate with the concerned vendor/supplier for specific accessory installation, wherever applicable
take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components
comply with standard operating procedures for fitment of the accessories in the vehicle as specified by the OEM
make holes/cuts on various surfaces such as metal sheet, plastic, fabric etc., for fitting accessories
remove dummy plugs, covers, old/damaged/defective parts of accessories and clean surrounding areas prior to installing/replacing accessories and its parts
perform wiring connection as specified by the OEM to fit electrical/electronic accessories
install and fit all exterior, interior, audio- visual, navigation and security related accessories as specified by OEM
ensure activation/calibration of accessories post installation such as enabling fog lamps/review camera, wheel balancing, wheel alignment etc.
ensure all accessories are installed/fitted/functioning properly
explain features, functioning and maintenance procedures of accessories to the customer
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment, and report if any malfunctions are observed, to the person concerned
ensure completeness of tasks assigned before releasing the vehicle
dispose off packing wraps/box/covers and other material as per organization’s policies
maintain documentation required on the job regarding the overall process of accessories fitment in the vehicle
